featuredEvent.title: Dutch Summer Sessions
featuredEvent.tagline: Music, food trucks, local vendors, DTG drops, Dutch Deck, and community nights at the home of Dutch Touch Genetics.
featuredEvent.description: Dutch Summer Sessions is the future weekly community event concept for Green Labs and Dutch Touch Genetics. The idea is simple: turn the property into a destination, not just a dispensary stop.
